_README: Shortlist for the Upcomers $25,000 Thunderbolt Classic instrument decision.
ASSUMPTION WARNING: every price/atr_price/spread_price below is a REPRESENTATIVE
value, not a measurement. They exist so the cost-per-R ranking can be produced
and reasoned about before the terminal is logged in, and they are replaced by
moment the server is reachable. Commission rates are NOT assumptions -- they are
the venue's published schedule and live in upcomers_rules.py.
atr_price is ATR on H1, approximated as daily_range_pct / 4.
spread_price is the quoted bid/ask in price units.

candidates.notes: Nasdaq-100 CFD, zero commission. Daily range ~1.5%, tick 0.25 => spread ~0.1-0.2 bps
S&P 500 CFD, zero commission. Daily range ~1.0%, most liquid index contract
DAX CFD, zero commission. European session -- best fit for a GMT+1 operator
Gold. $5/lot commission. The MIDASTOUCH instrument -- live-unprofitable, parked 2026-09-19
WTI filed under Indices by the venue; same zero-commission band. EIA-driven news risk
Tightest absolute spread, but $5/lot commission is ~1.0 pip per round trip
The only weekend-capable class. 0.04% commission = $80 round trip per BTC, before spread
